build.description: Default development agent for implementing features

plan.description: Planning agent for feature breakdown and architecture

qa.description: QA verification agent for testing and validation

scaffolder.description: Project scaffolding agent for initializing new projects

triage.description: Issue triage agent for managing backlog and prioritizing work

init.template: Use the gmacko-init-orchestrator skill to start the full project initialization workflow. Guide me through the interview process.

interview.description: Run project interview to generate manifest
interview.template: Use the gmacko-init-interview skill to conduct a project interview and generate PROJECT_MANIFEST.json.

feature.description: Plan a new feature with task breakdown
feature.template: Use the gmacko-dev-feature-plan skill to plan this feature: $ARGUMENTS

issue.template: Use the gmacko-dev-issue-create skill to create a GitHub issue for: $ARGUMENTS

review.template: Use the gmacko-dev-pr-review skill to review PR $ARGUMENTS

qa.description: Run QA verification for a feature
qa.template: Use the gmacko-qa-verify skill to verify: $ARGUMENTS

release.template: Use the gmacko-release-prepare skill to prepare a release.

deploy-web.template: Use the gmacko-release-deploy-web skill to deploy to Vercel. Target environment: $ARGUMENTS

deploy-mobile.description: Build and deploy mobile via EAS
deploy-mobile.template: Use the gmacko-release-deploy-mobile skill to build and deploy mobile apps.
